scope: Fresh post-Batch-375 shortest frontier; five compact skill mechanics/provenance records.

records.name: Spirit Ball
records.mechanics: Large controllable Ki ball; up to 17 additional inputs extend tracking for 1–18 hits; long-range/knockback.

records.name: Spirit Pulse
records.mechanics: Fast single spirit-energy strike from a forward fist thrust.

records.name: Chaos Wall
records.mechanics: Launches a Ki-blast-nullifying wall; holding enlarges it and increases speed/damage.

records.name: Sign of Awakening
records.mechanics: Rush multi-hit sequence into blue energy projectile; extra input vanishes behind the target for another attack.

records.name: Tail Slicer
records.mechanics: Sideways-moving tracking disc with directional input; blockability/unblockability is preserved as an unresolved source conflict.

validation.evidence_policy: No unsupported frame data, reward probabilities, hidden gates, or patch-independent damage values promoted.
